# Branch Mathematics Research Encyclopedia

Branch Mathematics is a public mathematical research encyclopedia.

## Main Pages

- Home: https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/
- Branch Mathematics: https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/branch-mathematics.html
- GURF: https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/gurf.html
- Encyclopedia: https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/encyclopedia.html

## Branch Mathematics

Branch Mathematics (BM) is meta-structural mathematics of lawful representation and transformation.

BM studies mathematical branches, interactions, roots, passports, leaves, trees, operations, configurations, interfaces, composition, realization, export, and re-entry.

## GURF

GURF is a mathematical framework for lawful system responses.

It studies information sufficiency, observation, intervention, constraints, regimes, continuation, obstruction, repair, and response.

## Research Policy

The encyclopedia distinguishes mathematical validity, derivation, conjecture, physical interpretation, novelty, and external validation.

The public website presents the mathematics and research record rather than conversational development history.
